name: Empirical PSF Factorization
definition: The PSF is factored into an amplitude component dependent on medium parameters ($T_{sv}$) and a normalized angular component (NPSF) independent of medium parameters, allowing interactive parameter changes without recomputing convolutions.
summary: Empirical PSF Factorization decouples the angular scattering profile from medium attenuation, enabling interactive parameter changes without recomputing expensive convolutions.
